## Change

Describe the contract-operations user story and the smallest coherent outcome delivered.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Added or updated `docs/execution-loop/phases/<phase>.json`; the ten steps are ordered and the predecessor/integrity/audit start gate is clear.
- [ ] Added or updated `docs/definition-of-done/features/<feature>.json` for every major feature in this change.
- [ ] Happy path and at least two failure paths are evidenced.
- [ ] Data integrity, audit, D1 migration, and R2 cleanup decisions are recorded where applicable.
- [ ] Authorization, invalid input, deterministic logic, demo fixtures, exports, assistant behavior, and accessibility are evidenced where applicable.
- [ ] README, demo runbook, roadmap status, limitations, and one bounded metric are updated.
- [ ] `npm run quality` passes.

Use `not_applicable` with a concrete rationale rather than silently omitting a criterion.
